ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.global_contrast_ratio: High-contrast bicolor distribution; approximately 65% high-intensity (white) to 35% low-intensity (black) pixels across the visible ventral surface.
ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.spatial_color_mapping: Contiguous low-intensity black pixel mass centered at the median notch, extending into the mid-lobes; peripheral zones dominated by high-intensity white pixels with irregular black linear streaks and small mottle clusters.

trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.median_notch_angle: V-shaped indentation with a calculated interior pixel angle of approximately 65 degrees; notch depth occupies approximately 12% of the total fluke vertical bounding box.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.edge_topography_serration_map: High-frequency, low-amplitude irregularities along the entire distal boundary; local peak-to-valley variance of 5-15 pixels, appearing more pronounced on the left lobe's upper margin.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.lobe_sweep_trajectory: Concave curvature along the distal margin of both lobes, sweeping upward and outward to sharp, slightly recurved tips.

localized_surface_anomalies.rosette_scar_constellations: Densely packed, low-luminance brown/tan pixel clusters localized on the extreme distal tips of both the left and right lobes.
localized_surface_anomalies.linear_abrasions: Cluster of 6 parallel, vertical low-intensity linear marks on the left lobe (rake marks); several intersecting diagonal linear disruptions on the right lobe.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Symmetrical parallel rake marks on the mid-left lobe; non-aligned linear crossing scars on the right lobe; barnacle colonization clusters on the extreme lateral tips.
other_distinctive_markers: A distinct, isolated black pixel streak near the center of the right lobe forming a roughly 'X' shaped intersection.
